training_context.adaptations: The base model was post-trained to produce an Instruct variant using SFT, DPO, and PPO. For the 7B model, three runs on 50B high-quality tokens with different data orders were averaged (weight soup) to produce the final model.
training_context.training_data: The OLMo 2 family was trained in two stages: first on OLMo-mix-1124, approximately 3.9 trillion tokens with over 95% web data, then on Dolmino-mix-1124, a smaller mixture of quality-filtered web data and domain-specific high-quality data, much of it synthetic.
